title: Effective angular rotor: relativistic dispersion, periodic decoherence and scale diagnostics
description: Research note with two original working manuscripts and a corrective technical addendum. Derives the free positive-frequency connection to Klein-Gordon, the nonrelativistic limit, and an explicitly periodic Lindblad generator. Includes numerical spectra and scale-exponent checks. These are consistency and computational checks of an effective model, not evidence for fundamental unification or experimental confirmation.
